The implementation removes that table with `ArrayOfTables::retain`; its prefix decoration owns the leading trivia (as `rewrite_rules_header` relies on), and `retain` does not transfer it to the next table. A repository-level `jit config set` therefore violates REQ-01/REQ-03’s byte-exact preservation when a user has reordered a removable default rule first. Existing drop tests cover middle and final rows, not the first-row case. `crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:218`
